newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see little business after USDA figure.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see little business after USDA figure.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw little business after the USDA 1996/97 soybean end stocks figure was unexpectately left unchanged at 140 million bushels, market sources said.

"Yesterday Chicago soycomplex futures rose limit-up in anticipation of a lower USDA soybean end stock and most sellers were not willing to offer material ahead of the figures. When the stocks turned out to be unchanged buyers disappeared, expecting Chicago futures to drop sharply," one broker said.
In other products a few trades were reported, mainly for nearby material on the back of a slightly lower dollar.

Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $146 a tonne cif Rotterdam, March at $141 and April/June at $139.50. Feb cornglutenfeed pellets changed hands at $150 a tonne cif Rotterdam and March at $143 a tonne cif.
March EU rapemeal traded at 33 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and August/Oct at 25.85 marks, up 0.20 from yesterday.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
